name: Carrion Crow
flavour: It has been circling for days. It got bored.
art_prompt: a big fat cartoon black crow with an oversized head and a thick pale ivory beak, an angry brow and two small pale yellow eyes, ragged black feathers with a clear blue sheen on the wings, both wings held half open and low at its sides like arms, two thin pale grey legs with big clawed feet, a short ragged black tail, one single crow, exactly two wings, facing the viewer
anim_negative: extra wings, a third wing, four wings, two heads, two beaks, extra legs, flying up, flying away, leaving the frame, feathers flying off, motion blur, smeared wings, a second crow
back_hint: seen directly from behind: the black feathered back and the tail, the two wings half open and held low with a touch of blue sheen, the head turned away so no beak and no eyes show, two thin legs below
dead_hint: lying flat on the ground on its side, dead: the black crow stretched out sideways across the picture with its head on the left and its tail on the right, one wing spread limp, its pale beak open, its eye shut as a small cross, legs curled up; it lies on nothing, with no ground, no sand and no shadow under it
doc: The Dust Bowl's runner: a big black crow that hops and flaps low over the ground in flocks of eight, fast and weak. A flock that arrives before the crowd does, gone at the first sweep.
